title: Sales/CS Bundle Orchestrator: initial scoping and economic brief for high-touch enterprise requests
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable 'Bundle Orchestrator' intake and first-pass scoping flow for Sales/CS that consolidates multiple enterprise feature asks into coherent implementation bundles with a quick economic estimate and suggested next-step roadmaps.
background: Sales and CS frequently bring grouped asks from strategic accounts that are expressed as several interdependent feature requests. Currently PM triage treats each ask in isolation, causing duplicated scoping work, inconsistent comms to customers, and missed opportunities to propose bundled pricing or phased rollouts. This ticket defines a structured artifact and process for consolidating asks, scoring bundle feasibility, and producing a one-page brief for stakeholders.
goals: 1) Reduce first-response scoping time from days to <48 hours for high-touch requests. 2) Standardize bundle-level econ heuristics so AMs can surface realistic cost+timeline ranges. 3) Produce a single artifact that can be reviewed by Engineering, Solutions, and Pricing in a lightweight sync.
out_of_scope: Detailed engineering estimates, final Go/No-Go enterprise contracts, or multi-quarter roadmap commitments. This is for initial scoping and econ guidance only.
scope: Inputs: Sales/CS intake form entries, customer call notes, existing feature requests. Outputs: Bundle Orchestrator brief (single page), prioritization score, suggested next-step (Discovery / PoC / Pilot / Backlog), and a recommended price tier or resource commitment.
proposed_solution_outline: 1) Intake consolidation template that maps related requests to capability areas. 2) A 5-factor bundle scoring rubric (customer value, engineering effort, dependencies, security/compliance risk, revenue potential). 3) Quick econ calculator with default velocity assumptions and cost-per-engineer-week. 4) Triage play: Discovery -> Pilot -> Backlog -> Reject. 5) Stakeholder readout checklist and ownership handoff lines.
initial_risks: - Over-aggregating unrelated requests and masking technical complexity. - Miscalibrated econ assumptions leading to underpricing pilots. - Engineering bandwidth contention if many bundles proceed to discovery at once.
acceptance_criteria: A reusable Bundle Orchestrator brief template exists in Confluence and can be completed in <= 60 minutes by an AE/CS with PM support.
A scoring rubric and calculator spreadsheet is published and includes default assumptions; PMs can override assumptions per account.
Pilot/Discovery recommendation outcomes map to clear next steps owners (Solutions, Eng, Pricing) and a communicated SLA for follow-up.
Two trial bundles are scoped using the template (one inbound from Sales, one from CS) and reviewed in a cross-functional sync; feedback incorporated.
Metrics for success defined: time-to-first-response, % bundles moving to Discovery, and accuracy band for initial econ estimates vs actual cost.
Stakeholder sign-off from Sales Lead and Head of Solutions recorded in the brief for both trials.
tasks: Draft Bundle Orchestrator template in Confluence and link to existing intake form.
Design 5-factor scoring rubric and default weights; publish a one-page cheat-sheet.
Build quick econ calculator (Google Sheets) with fields: estimated eng-weeks, infra delta, onboarding effort, pilot discount guidance.
Run two pilot scoping sessions with cross-functional attendees and capture feedback.
Iterate template and rubric based on pilots; finalize handoff checklist and SLAs.
Create a short training doc for Sales/CS and schedule a 30-min walkthrough with AEs and Solutions engineers.
Instrument a lightweight dashboard (notebook) to track bundle throughput and estimate variance to actuals.
Identify criteria that auto-escalate bundles to 'enterprise intake squad' for immediate PM assignment.
Document recommended pricing uplift bands and common contract triggers for bundled features.
Prepare a 1-page summary for leadership with sample econ outcomes and resource asks for Q2.
Link resulting brief to Linear ticket for each bundled request to maintain audit trail.
